Apideva
poet. Skm. p. 51. See Āpideva. [Page255-b]

Apipāla
son of Dehṛṇapāla, son of Trivikrama, son of Makarandapāla.
--Apipālakārikā. Q. in Malamāsa an. other tattvas of Raghunandana.
--Śūdrapaddhati (based on Soma Miśra).

.
--Q. also by Govindānanda Kavikaṅkaṇa in his Śrāddhakriyākaumudī. Bib. Ind. edn. 1904, p.. 56, 388.

Apītakucanāyikāstava
stotra. probably by Appayya Dīkṣita. Śakti 120. See the following.

Apītakucāmbāstava
stotra on the Goddess a. Tiruvaṇṇāmalai by Appayya Dīkṣita. Adyar I. p. 185a. Trav.

I.
This stotra is also called Jvaraharāṣṭaka an. was composed by Appayya Dīkṣita to relieve himself of the trouble caused to him by a. evil-minded mendicant. (See col. in Adyar ms. Iti Dīkṣitavaryakṛta-durmatisannyāsiviṣayaka-jvaraharāṣṭakam sampūrṇam).
Pt.. Vāṇī Vilās Press, Srirangam.
